title.zh: Osmosis社区通过提案，将停止OSMO通胀发行并转向协议收入分配
title.en: Osmosis社区通过提案，将停止OSMO通胀发行并转向协议收入分配

current_state.zh: Osmosis governance approved Proposal 1053 to end OSMO inflation issuance, tie staking rewards entirely to protocol revenue and burns, and pause roughly 51.9 million OSMO in developer vesting until a separate governance decision.
current_state.en: Osmosis governance approved Proposal 1053 to end OSMO inflation issuance, tie staking rewards entirely to protocol revenue and burns, and pause roughly 51.9 million OSMO in developer vesting until a separate governance decision.
